Tips

What is documented via the business itself on the page cited is only the classification as a holiday house, the house number, the postcode and the telephone and fax number. The number of rooms, the kitchen, Wi-Fi, pets, check-in times and prices should be clarified directly on +43 5234 32046 or via the form on Tirol.de before a booking. Older descriptive texts that claim a position at the edge of the woods, a view of the Karnische Alpen or proximity to hiking paths, without naming a source, are not repeated here.
